title: fix(sdk): use matching extensions for transcription Blob uploads
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: The SDK now gives unnamed transcription Blobs filenames that match their audio MIME subtype, stripping MIME parameters, normalizing `x-` prefixes, and using `.mp3` for MPEG audio. Explicit File names remain unchanged; raw buffers and Blobs with empty or non-audio MIME types still fall back to MP3. Regression tests now cover WAV and parameterized WebM filenames, MIME types, and contents. The SDK prerelease version, standalone lockfile, and changelog were updated.
